units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:8">Dem. VII, 8</cite> <he>נוטל שתי חביות ל׳</he> he must take two barrels from diagonally opposite corners.

<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 7:8">Ib.</cite> <he>שורה אחת ל׳</he> one row of barrels following the diagonal line. Y. Kil. IV, 29ᶜ top <he>במודד לכסן</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:6">Kil. IV, 6</cite> <cite ref="A01891"><he>אלכסון</he></cite>) when he measures by diagonal lines.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:5:3">Y. Yoma V, 42ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חוץ מזו שהיתה לפניו ל׳</he> except that (corner of the altar) which was diagonally opposite to him. Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 1) <he>חורש שדהו לוכסון וכ׳</he> ploughed his field crosswise and put up an image in the center &c.; a. e.
